chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Ibrāhīm, who said:
I wrote to him asking him about salat (prayer) in the skins of rabbits, and he wrote: It is disliked.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual worship under discussion
key_terms.الْأَرَانِبِ: rabbits, whose skins are being asked about
key_terms.جُلُودِ: skins or hides used as garments or material
key_terms.مَكْرُوهَةٌ: disliked; legally discouraged though not explicitly forbidden in this wording

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on praying in rabbit skins according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling regarding salat (prayer) performed in rabbit skins. The response given is that it is makruh, indicating disapproval in the legal sense rather than absolute prohibition.
